question: Among large-cap 4%-down days (short side), does sector strength (sector_rs) grade the short trade -- do names in already-weak sectors fall harder than names in strong sectors? Expect lower sector_rs=better short, i.e. top-minus-bottom effect negative.
plain: Do breakdowns in already-weak sectors keep falling harder than breakdowns in strong sectors, or does the sector not matter once the stock itself is breaking down?
